# Billy

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Billy is a twenty-year-old youth who is described as big and fat. He has a round, expressionless face and maintains a stolid appearance.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is a large, stout youth of twenty who possesses a round, expressionless face. He is characterized by a stolid and untalkative nature, exhibiting a notable lack of conversational skills and rarely engaging in laughter or chatter.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- stolid and untalkative  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy assisted [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) by driving them to the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for a charity concert. Following the event and a supper, he drove the girls back home. During the carriage ride back, Billy listened as the group discussed high society, the concert's performances, and Anne's hair.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P7](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P8](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P11](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. ## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy--jane-andrews.md)

Jane is Billy's sister. They travel together to attend and return from a charity concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel), with Billy providing the carriage ride for Jane, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md). Following the event, they share a scenic drive home while discussing the evening's performances and high society.

- Sibling of — brother and sister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>
